Name: Xtardew Valley - Compatibility Patch
Author: darthalex2014
Description:
[size=4][color=#6aa84f]This script [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]removes events[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f] from the original Xtardew Valley that are [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]duplicated[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f] in [b]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/b].[/color]

[color=#6aa84f]As a result, you get all the [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]new events[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f] from [b]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/b], plus around [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]30 old events[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f], [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]new dialogues[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f], [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]mail[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f], and [/color][b][u][color=#3d85c6]schedules[/color][/u][/b][color=#6aa84f] for NPCs that aren't included in [b]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/b]![/color][/size]

[b][u][size=3]This script does not contain any files from the original mods!
It's simply a tool that removes duplicate events from Xtardew Valley![/size][/u][/b]

[size=4][b]Big thanks to [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1706874]pseudodiego[/url][b] for [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url][b]! [/b]
[b]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/181571973]hixega[/url]﻿ for [/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16739]Xtardew Female[/url]!
[b][size=3]Большое спасибо [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/132956868]MetaKage[/url] за [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27635]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/url]![/size][/b]

[spoiler][url=https://fastpic.org/view/124/2024/1105/55e8719eb154273785446ee1d8890729.png.html][img]https://i124.fastpic.org/big/2024/1105/29/55e8719eb154273785446ee1d8890729.png[/img][/url]

[size=3]1) Скачиваете [b]Xtardew Valley - Compatibility Patch.exe[/b] помещаете в отдельную папку. Запускаете. 
2) Выбираете какой мод вам нужен [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url] [/b]или[b] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url][/b] [/b]+[b] [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16739]Xtardew Female[/url][/b].[b] [/b]Жмете продолжить. [u][b](Программа сама создаст папки)[/b][/u]
3) Скачиваете [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url] [u]v3.1.1[/u] [/b]и[b] [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16739]Xtardew Female[/url][/b] (Если он вам нужен). Распаковываете моды с помощью [url=https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z2408-x64.exe]7-Zip[/url] и помещаете папки в папки которые создал [b]Xtardew Valley - Compatibility Patch. [u]Вот так:[/u][/b]
